subject.title: fix(config): key agentDir collisions by volume case sensitivity

question: Should trusted safe-bin comparison adopt this probing-based component identity helper together with agent-directory collision detection?
rationale: The implementation appears correct, but changing safe-bin path equivalence determines which executable directories cross an execution trust boundary and requires explicit owner acceptance.

options.title: Approve the shared invariant

options.title: Limit this PR to agentDir
options.body: Remove the safe-bin integration from this PR and track the security-boundary consolidation as separately reviewed work.

options.title: Require Windows host proof
options.body: Hold merge until the same production path is demonstrated on a Windows volume with per-directory case sensitivity enabled.
